---
title: "FCECPR Training Registration Form"
subtitle: "Open-ended feedback (anonymized)"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%B %d, %Y')`"
output:
  word_document:
    reference_docx: reference.docx
    md_extensions: "-tex_math_single_backslash"
params:
  project_dir: "."
  data_rds: "output/prepared_data.rds"
  seed: 2026
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 6.5, dpi = 200)
source(file.path(params$project_dir, "R", "functions.R"))
dat <- readRDS(params$data_rds)

fb_q <- dat$questions %>% filter(is_feedback) %>% arrange(order)
open_q <- fb_q %>% filter(type == "text")
rated_q <- fb_q %>% filter(type %in% c("choice", "matrix"))

# Anyone who answered at least one feedback question
fb_answers <- dat$answers %>% filter(tag %in% fb_q$tag, !is.na(num))
n_fb <- n_distinct(fb_answers$ResponseId)

# Names to strip from comments: everything identifying typed anywhere in the form
id_cols <- c("Provider", "Contact_1", "Contact_4", "Trainers_1", "Trainers_3", "Trainers_5",
             "Signer_1", "Signer_3", "Signature", "Location_1")
id_cols <- intersect(id_cols, names(dat$raw_numeric))
names_to_redact <- unlist(dat$raw_numeric[id_cols], use.names = FALSE)
```

```{r intro, results = "asis"}
cat(sprintf(paste0(
  "%d respondent(s) answered at least one question in the feedback section. ",
  "Comments are shown verbatim, grouped by question, with no response IDs or applicant details. ",
  "Within each question the order is shuffled so comments cannot be lined up across questions. ",
  "Email addresses, phone numbers, links and any provider, contact, trainer or signer name typed elsewhere in the form are replaced with [email], [phone], [link] and [name]. ",
  "Read through once before sharing: other identifying details (for example a training title or a city) are not removed automatically.\n\n"),
  n_fb))
```

# Open-ended responses

```{r verbatims, results = "asis"}
set.seed(params$seed)
for (k in seq_len(nrow(open_q))) {
  q <- open_q[k, ]
  col <- q$cols[[1]][1]
  qtext <- dat$columns$label[dat$columns$col == col]
  qtext <- str_squish(str_remove(qtext, "^[^\n]* - (?=[^\n]*$)"))
  txt <- dat$answers %>% filter(col == !!col, !is.na(num)) %>% pull(num)
  shown <- dat$qstatus %>% filter(tag == q$tag, applicable, reached) %>% nrow()
  trivial <- is_trivial_response(txt)
  keep <- txt[!trivial]
  keep <- anonymize_text(keep, names_to_redact)
  keep <- keep[sample.int(length(keep))]

  cat("## ", md_escape(qtext), "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(styled(sprintf("%d comment(s) from %d respondent(s) who reached this question%s.",
                     length(keep), shown,
                     if (sum(trivial)) sprintf("; %d more answered only 'none', 'n/a' or similar", sum(trivial)) else ""),
             "Muted"), "\n\n", sep = "")
  if (length(keep) == 0) {
    cat("No comments.\n\n")
  } else {
    for (t in keep) {
      cat("- ", gsub("\n\n", "\n\n  ", md_text(t)), "\n", sep = "")
    }
    cat("\n")
  }
}
```

```{r rated-head, results = "asis"}
if (nrow(rated_q) > 0) {
  cat("# Rated questions in the feedback section\n\n",
      "Shown for context alongside the comments. 1 = Strongly disagree, 5 = Strongly agree.\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{r rated-table}
if (nrow(rated_q) > 0) {
  rated <- dat$answers %>%
    filter(tag %in% rated_q$tag) %>%
    left_join(dat$columns %>% select(col, label), by = "col") %>%
    mutate(item = if_else(is.na(sublabel), str_squish(str_split_i(label, "\n", 1)), str_squish(sublabel)),
           score = suppressWarnings(as.integer(num))) %>%
    left_join(dat$questions %>% select(tag, order), by = "tag")
  item_order <- rated %>% distinct(item, order, col) %>% arrange(order, col) %>% pull(item) %>% unique()
  rated_tbl <- rated %>%
    filter(!is.na(score)) %>%
    group_by(Item = factor(item, levels = item_order)) %>%
    summarise(Responses = n(), Mean = sprintf("%.1f", mean(score)),
              `Agree (4-5)` = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * mean(score >= 4)),
              `Disagree (1-2)` = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * mean(score <= 2)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Item = as.character(Item))
  rated_tbl %>% flextable() %>% ft_style(font_size = 9) %>%
    align(j = 2:5, align = "center", part = "all") %>%
    width(j = 1, width = 3.5) %>% width(j = 2:5, width = 0.75) %>% set_table_properties(layout = "fixed")
}
```

```{r rated-plot, fig.height = 3.6}
if (nrow(rated_q) > 0 && any(!is.na(rated$score))) {
  plot_df <- rated %>% filter(!is.na(score)) %>%
    count(item, score) %>%
    group_by(item) %>% mutate(share = n / sum(n)) %>% ungroup() %>%
    mutate(item = factor(str_wrap(item, 45), levels = rev(str_wrap(item_order, 45))),
           score = factor(score, levels = 5:1))
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(share, item, fill = score)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = likert_colors, breaks = as.character(1:5),
                      labels = c("1 Strongly disagree", "2", "3", "4", "5 Strongly agree"), name = NULL) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(round(100 * x), "%"), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(title = "Distribution of ratings", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
    theme_report(base_size = 8.5) +
    theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), legend.text = element_text(size = 7.5))
}
```
